title: Ice Thistle Hills
wikitext:
[[Image:Ice Thistle Hills.jpg|thumb|Ice Thistle Hills]]
The '''Ice Thistle Hills''' is a large area just southeast of [[Everlook]]. It is the home of the [[Ice Thistle]] [[yeti]], who live in and around a cave some way up in the hill, and in the surrounding area. Adventurers often come here to find [[Thick Yeti Fur]]s and [[Pristine Yeti Horn]]s for their quests.

This area is a popular place to farm leather, as the yeti also drop money and "humanoid" drops (excepting cloth) such as poor quality armor. One can also find [[Icecap]]s around the outdoor area, [[Thorium]] veins inside the cave, and, if one is very lucky, a [[Black Lotus]] at the lip of the cave.
